note: BLM Kemmerer Field Office campground on the inside of a Green River bend just below Fontenelle Dam, upstream of Seedskadee NWR; picnic tables and grills, fishing and boat access. BLM runs it for Reclamation. --Claude
summary: BLM page confirms 10 campsites with tables, grills, a vault toilet, fishing/boat access; rec.gov 14718 info-only (FCFS); fees free per the stored 2022 BLM release (current page silent on fees). Riverfront holds on imagery: the north loop runs 10-15 m from a ~40-55 m channel over open ground. Pin ~55 m from the loops, fine.
flags: WATERFRONT confirmed riverfront (not --AWH): the campground's north loop road runs along the bank of the Green River (channel ~40-55 m wide below the dam) 10-15 m from the water with open ground and scattered single trees between; an occupied site at about 42.02106,-110.04853 sits ~25 m from the water. BLM publishes no site numbers or map.

Note: removed '(motorboats prohibited)': the BLM page says 'the area is restricted to motorboats', which is ambiguous; not restated. Vault toilet, site count and the no-potable-water value are fields (potable_water false is derived; the BLM page is silent, left).

Fees 0/0 stay on the 2022 BLM press release; the live page does not mention a fee. Season and rig length: silent. Phone 307-828-4500 and website confirmed. Pin 42.02040,-110.04870 is ~55 m S of the loop centroid (about 42.0209,-110.0485): fine.
